web.note: No dedicated test-runner script in web/package.json; biome check + tsc serve as quality gates

test_dirs.purpose: Unit tests with rich conftest.py fixtures (config, llm, session, runtime, all individual tools, temp work/home dirs, mock chat provider)
End-to-end tests exercising the CLI as a subprocess over a JSON-RPC wire protocol, with inline-snapshot assertions on normalized message sequences
AI accuracy smoke tests run via 'make ai-test' (uv run tests_ai/scripts/run.py)
SDK-level smoke test using httpx.MockTransport to fake chat-completions endpoint

e2e_tests.description: The CLI is launched as a subprocess (uv run kimi --wire) and driven via stdin/stdout JSON-RPC 2.0. wire_helpers.py provides start_wire/send_initialize/collect_until_response helpers. A scripted echo chat provider (kosong _scripted_echo) reads JSON script files to produce deterministic LLM responses.
e2e_tests.assertions: inline-snapshot snapshot() on summarized/normalized event-message sequences
e2e_tests.normalization: Path replacement (tmp/home/work dirs), UUID normalization, line-ending normalization, shell-language normalization for cross-platform determinism

fixtures.summary: Heavyweight fixture factory pattern: a 'runtime' fixture composes Config, LLM (MockChatProvider), Session, BuiltinSystemPromptArgs, DenwaRenji, Approval, LaborMarket, Environment, NotificationManager, BackgroundTaskManager, OAuthManager into a fully-wired Runtime. Individual tool fixtures (AgentTool, Shell, ReadFile, WriteFile, etc.) each wrap the runtime fixture. LLM is mocked via kosong.chat_provider.mock.MockChatProvider([]) returning predefined StreamedMessagePart lists.
fixtures.mocking_providers: Unit tests use MockChatProvider([]) (kosong). E2E tests use a scripted echo provider (type=_scripted_echo) driven by JSON script files specifying text/tool_call/usage lines.

coverage.note: No [tool.coverage] table, no addopts with --cov, no pytest-cov dependency in pyproject.toml. Coverage is not collected or gated in CI.

jobs.check: make check-kimi-cli => ruff check, ruff format --check, pyright, (ty check || true)
jobs.test: make test-kimi-cli => uv run pytest tests -vv && uv run pytest tests_e2e -vv
jobs.build: PyInstaller one-file binary smoke test (--help) across ubuntu/macos/windows, then upload artifacts

proposal: ai-factory could emulate kimi-cli's deterministic subprocess-e2e + inline-snapshot pattern: launch the factory orchestrator as a subprocess with a scripted mock LLM provider that replays predefined tool-call/reply sequences from JSON, then assert against normalized snapshot() of the emitted event stream (turn/step/tool-call/approval ordering) to lock down multi-agent handover behavior and catch regressions in orchestration logic without touching real LLM APIs.
